name: Paging Console — Restore Normal Button
description: When an alarm disarmed MQTT message arrives, restore slot 1 on the paging console panel to the standard operations action. Pair with 7.11a which sets the emergency action on arm. Together they form a stateful paging console button that reflects the current security posture of the site.

actions.message: Paging console slot 1 restored to Normal Operations (alarm disarmed at {{timestamp}})
